appName.description: The extension's name: the Web Store title and chrome://extensions. Keep "Tab Keeper" first and untranslated. At most 75 characters.

appDesc.message: See open windows and saved sessions side by side. Save tabs and tab groups in one click, switch sessions, and sync with no sign-up.
appDesc.description: The Web Store summary under the title. At most 132 characters. Never say sessions sync "through Chrome sync".

actionTitle.description: The toolbar icon's tooltip: the product name only, never translated.
